text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Phew~ Kita-chan, Spe-chan! Want to grab a 
bite to eat after practice?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
*pant* *pant*... Yes, with pleasure! I'll 
tag along for whatever you want to eat, 
Teio-san!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm happy with anything as long as it's 
delicious, desu!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Geez, are you two doing that again? You 
know, it's fine for me to match what you 
two want once in a while!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
No no, just being able to go food hopping 
with the two of you is already a grand 
feast for me!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I totally get that! Food just tastes 
so much better when you eat it with 
friends, desu_ne!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The secret to delicious food isn't *what* 
you eat, but *who* you eat with, after 
all!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph. So both of you were looking 
forward to hanging out with me that much, 
huh? Heheh♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, can't be helped then! After school 
today, we're settling on Hachimii waffles 
with a drink!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes, understood! Hachimii with Teio-san 
and Spe-san, I can't wait! Woohoo!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Um, sorry, Teio-san! Even though I said 
anything was fine, I'd really love to eat 
a proper main course too, desu!
